surprises: *** THE FEED WOULD HAVE CONVERTED NOTHING, SILENTLY. *** _TS_RE hardcoded BOTH `bronze/netassets/` AND `.html`, and the classifier returned a hardcoded feed='netassets', so a TrueShares HOLDINGS bronze key fell through to 'unrecognized'. The new feed would have been declared, wired, gate-clean and produced zero rows with no error anywhere. Found by reading the PRODUCER'S OWN LANDING MAP (_bronze_key, monolith grammar) to learn the key the regex had to match, instead of assuming the shape from the netassets sibling. The risk-reflex then made me read a July record documenting the SAME CLASS one layer down: a seat retracting their own census row because 'my census derived expected silver prefix FROM the bronze prefix, so a feed violating that assumption read ABSENT rather than UNMEASURED'. A mapping assumption making a real thing read as absent.

*** MY OWN CONV-1 RULING WAS FALSIFIED BY ITS OWN IMPLEMENTATION, AT 96% OF ROWS. *** The live filepoint feed carries a BLANK MoneyMarketFlag on 110 of 114 rows and NEVER writes 'N' -- so blank is this vendor's ENCODING FOR NO, not an absence of assertion, and `vendor-blank -> is_cash MUST be null` would have flipped 110 rows from a known False to NULL. The defect was in the VALUE'S WORDING -- Rule 24(iii) inside a value, the same test I had used to reject `name-inferred` and `none` in that very enum six hours earlier. I STOPPED and routed rather than re-ruling mid-build, per AC2's own instruction.

AND I HAD READ THE EVIDENCE AGAINST ME AS EVIDENCE FOR ME. I quoted etf_schemas.py's dtype law approvingly as corroboration for CONV-1 -- 'mapping \'\' to False would be null-meaning judgment'. That line says the vendor tier must not decide BECAUSE '' IS AMBIGUOUS, i.e. the question is OPEN. I read it as the answer. A source saying 'this question is open' reads almost identically to one saying 'and here is the answer' when you already have an answer, and there is nothing to recompute -- only re-reading catches it.

THE CUSIP COLUMN CARRIES THREE DISTINCT CORRUPTION MODES, NOT ONE, and the residual held all of them rather than coercing any into a kind it is not. (a) LEADING ZEROS STRIPPED -- 5 rows, RECOVERABLE: zero-pad to 9 and the check digit passes 5 of 5, with negative controls (CASHEUR, ZZZZZZZ) failing and a positive control (SALXX) passing, so it is not coincidence at 1-in-10 per row. (b) GENUINE SEDOLs -- 2 rows (6455819, B247XZ6), not CUSIPs at all. (c) SCIENTIFIC-NOTATION MANGLING -- RTX `7.55E+105`, which is 75513E101 read as a NUMBER by a spreadsheet. ⛔ (c) IS IRREVERSIBLE where (a) is not: the digits are gone and there is nothing to deterministically recover. LENGTH DOES NOT SEPARATE ANY OF THEM -- ABT is 7 chars and recovers, ICT is 7 chars and does not; only the check digit discriminates.

A CORRECT IMPLEMENTATION PRINTED 'DIVERGES' ON ALL FOUR VALUES because the corpus moved under the test: the 22:00Z fire landed a 73rd partition mid-exercise (7,892 -> 8,079 rows). Re-scoped to the ruling's own 72 partitions it matches 4 of 4 with rows 7892 == 7892. A frozen figure compared against a moved corpus is indistinguishable from a broken implementation, and the fix is to stamp every count with the denominator it was taken over.
